get.summary: Get all the credit account ids related to this team
get.description:
Requires any of scopes `cardtransactions.all` or `cardtransactions.read`
This is used as a first step to enable the use of the below endpoints, which will all require the credit account id.

get.summary: Get the transactions related to a specific credit account
get.description:
Requires any of scopes `cardtransactions.all` or `cardtransactions.read`
This endpoint supports filtering by the transaction status with StatusFilter, and pagination using the fields limit and offset

get.summary: Get a specific transaction related to a specific credit account.

patch.summary: Use this endpoint to update the bookkeeping details of a credit account transaction
patch.description:
Requires any of scopes `cardtransactions.all` or `cardtransactions.update`
It might not include late fees, rebates and other small variations hence might not be fully accurate

get.summary: Get the payments related to a specific credit account
Get a specific payment related to a specific credit account
This endpoint returns the total account balance for the credit account at the time of the query
get.description:
Requires any of scopes `cardtransactions.all` or `cardtransactions.read`
It might not include late fees, rebates and other small variations hence might not be fully accurate

get.summary: This endpoint is used to enable the items feature for the team.
get.description:
Requires scope `items.write`
This feature will enable item-based expense lines on the expense documents of the team.

get.summary: This endpoint is used to disable the items feature for the team.
get.description:
Requires scope `items.write`
This feature will disable item-based expense lines on the expense documents of the team.

put.summary: This endpoint can be used to add new items to the list of existing items.

post.summary: This endpoint can be used to overwrite the existing item list with new items, disabling old items not found in the new list.

get.summary: This endpoint can be used to fetch all the items on the team.
